ValidationRule.description: Implemented as a part of the Zift Partner Portal project. Jira ticket SS-8945
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED (Mapped_Opportunity__c), TEXT(or_Opp_Reg_Approval_Flow_Status__c) = 'Approvals not started', TEXT(or_Opp_Reg_Status__c) = 'Pending', or_New_Opp_Reg__c, LEN(Mapped_Opportunity__r.Deal_Reg_ID__c) > 0, OR( TEXT(Mapped_Opportunity__r.Deal_Reg_ID__r.or_Opp_Reg_Status__c) = 'Approved', TEXT(Mapped_Opportunity__r.Deal_Reg_ID__r.or_Opp_Reg_Status__c) = 'Extension Pending', TEXT(Mapped_Opportunity__r.Deal_Reg_ID__r.or_Opp_Reg_Status__c) = 'Closed Won' ), NOT($Profile.Name="API Only Integration Admin"), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The opportunity that you are trying to map has a Deal Registration connected. Please either (i) select an alternate opportunity, (ii)select “Create new opp upon approval”, or (iii) reject the Deal Registration as this opportunity is already registered.
